currentPage.seoDescription: We believe local churches are the hope of the world. Here’s how we partner with pastors and church leaders worldwide to spread the love of Christ through free
currentPage.seoKeywords: Open Network, next steps, growth, tools, purpose, church resources, free resources, free

00.headingText: Free sermons, kids curriculum, graphics, and more for churches.

02.content: From downloadable sermon outlines to complete kids curriculum packages to message series graphics, Life.Church Open Network has thousands of high-quality, easy-to-use resources that will help you reach the people you’re uniquely called to reach.

0.content: With over 100,000 free resources on Open Network, there’s a lot to choose from. We recommend exploring these resources first.
Get a head start creating messages on habits, marriage, anxiety, and more.

01.title: Kids Curriculum
01.content: Save time and money on kids ministry with the free Bible Adventure curriculum.

00.headingText: The Church Online Platform is a great way to engage your attenders online and lead them to next steps. The best part? It’s completely free!
